title: Dynamic Interface using Object Set Data Source
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Runtime rebinding of form object data sources

historical_commentary.text: OBJECT SET DATA SOURCE, introduced in v14, remains a supported way to rebind a form object's data source at runtime and is still used for dynamic, single-form-many-fields UIs; it now coexists with (rather than being replaced by) ORDA-based dynamic binding to entity attributes, and generic listbox/collection-driven UI patterns that emerged later.
related_updates: ORDA entity attributes and dynamic collection-bound list boxes provide additional/alternative ways to build data-driven dynamic forms in later 4D versions
